# SOPHIA — Gospel of Mary, Chapter 3
**Agent:** SOPHIA (Consensus)
**Source:** P.Berol. 8502, Gospel of Mary, p. 5-6 | Coptic
**Chapter:** 3

---

[Pages 1-6 of the manuscript are lost. Chapter 3 falls entirely within the missing pages. No text survives.]

---

*Council Note (SOPHIA):* Unanimous across all agents. Chapter 3 is part of the six-page lacuna at the beginning of P.Berol. 8502. The surviving text begins mid-sentence on page 7, which corresponds to chapter 4. No reconstruction is attempted.
